data.one_liner: Flutter widget library providing a collection of ready‑to‑use text animation effects.
data.what_it_does: It supplies a set of pre‑built animated text widgets such as fade, rotate, typewriter, and new scramble or bounce effects. The widgets are configurable and can be controlled programmatically via an AnimatedTextController.
use_when: You need eye‑catching text animations without writing custom animation code
You want a quick way to add multiple text effects in a single widget
You require runtime control over start, pause, or reset of text animations
avoid_when: You need complex, non‑text animations or fine‑grained physics‑based motion
Performance is critical for animating large numbers of widgets
strengths: Wide variety of built‑in text animations
Simple API with many configurable properties
weaknesses: Customization beyond provided parameters may require custom code
Adds an extra widget layer which could affect performance in large lists
